description: Implementation of the xnap_impl class handling XNAP protocol messages, including setup requests and outcomes, with external dependencies on ASN.1 encoding and XNAP message processing.

classes.name: xnap_impl
classes.description: Class implementing XNAP protocol handling, including message processing and setup procedures.

methods.name: handle_message

methods.description: Handles initiating messages, specifically XN setup requests.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
